title: Q-AUDIT-selftest-data: fm-frozen-page failing (fail): Find the generator named in the file header; make the workflow that runs it land the file through scripts/land_data.py, then rerun.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe selftest-data
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-frozen-page` detected by `selftest-data`, failing since 2026-11-25T21:05:50Z.
Evidence: site/feed-data.js: generated 199 h ago, limit 168 h (frozen; its generator is not running or not landing)

Signature: 7abc8a3c83c3 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a generator that feeds a public page stopped running, or its output never lands on main
Files the evidence names: `site/feed-data.js`
Remedy: Find the generator named in the file header; make the workflow that runs it land the file through scripts/land_data.py, then rerun.
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe selftest-data

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T03:14:49Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
